result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [VariableMetadata]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | Pointblank description: The metadata for a single variable (column). twitter-card: title: >- [VariableMetadata]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | Pointblank description: The metadata for a single variable (column). title: >- [VariableMetadata]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: The metadata for a single variable (column). page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} The metadata for a single variable (column). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/metadata/_types.py#L368-L582){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-class} ```pythonsignature VariableMetadata( name, label=None, description=None, dtype=None, role=None, required=False, unique=False, min_val=None, max_val=None, min_length=None, max_length=None, pattern=None, allowed_values=None, codelist_ref=None, display_format=None, value_labels=None, missing_values=None, missing_value_labels=None, origin=None, computational_method=None, controlled_term=None, significant_digits=None, cdisc_domain=None, cdisc_role=None, adam_derivation=None, traceability_ref=None, unit=None, unit_system=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A [`MetadataImport`](`pointblank.MetadataImport`) holds one `VariableMetadata` for each variable described in the imported file. It gathers everything the file says about the variable in one place: its name, label and type, the constraints on its values, any value labels and missing-value codes, and (for clinical data) its CDISC attributes. Each format fills in the fields it has information for and leaves the rest as `None`. Some fields are used to generate validation steps in [`MetadataImport.to_validate()`](`pointblank.MetadataImport.to_validate`): `dtype` (in the schema check), `required`, `unique`, `min_val` and `max_val`, `allowed_values`, `pattern` and `missing_values`. All of the constraint fields, including `min_length` and `max_length`, are written out by [`export_metadata()`](`pointblank.export_metadata`). The other fields are descriptive, and are kept so that you can use them in your own checks or reports. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The name of the variable, which should match the column name in the data. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A short human-readable label, such as `"Age in years"`. The default is `None`. [description]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A longer description of the variable. The default is `None`. [dtype]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The data type, as a Pointblank dtype name such as `"String"`, `"Int64"`, `"Float64"`, `"Boolean"`, `"Date"` or `"Datetime"`. The default is `None` (an unknown type, treated as `"String"` when a schema is made). [role]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The role of the variable in the dataset, as given by the source. The default is `None`. [required]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether the variable must have a value in every row. The default is `False`. [unique]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether every value must be different. The default is `False`. [min_val]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The smallest allowed value (inclusive). The default is `None`. [max_val]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The largest allowed value (inclusive). The default is `None`. [min_length]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The shortest allowed string length. The default is `None`. [max_length]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The longest allowed string length, such as the `Length` of a Define-XML variable. The default is `None`. [pattern]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A regular expression that values must match. The default is `None`. [allowed_values]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[Any] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The list of values the variable may take, usually the values of its codelist. The default is `None`. [codelist_ref]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The name of the variable's [`Codelist`](`pointblank.Codelist`) in `MetadataImport.codelists`. The default is `None`. [display_format]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The display format from the source system, such as the SPSS format `"F8.2"`. The default is `None`. [value_labels]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[Any, str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A mapping of values to labels, such as `{1: "Male", 2: "Female"}` for an SPSS variable. The default is `None`. [missing_values]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[Any] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The values that stand for missing data, such as `[-99, -98]` or `["NA"]`. The default is `None`. [missing_value_labels]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[Any, str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A mapping of missing values to labels, such as `{-99: "Refused"}`. The default is `None`. [origin]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : How the variable's values were obtained, such as `"CRF"`, `"Derived"` or `"Assigned"` in Define-XML. The default is `None`. [computational_method]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : How a derived variable is computed. The default is `None`. [controlled_term]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The name of the CDISC Controlled Terminology codelist the variable uses. The default is `None`. [significant_digits]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of significant digits of a numeric variable. The default is `None`. [cdisc_domain]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The CDISC domain or dataset that the variable belongs to, such as `"DM"` or `"AE"`. The default is `None`. [cdisc_role]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The CDISC role of the variable, such as `"Identifier"`, `"Topic"` or `"Record Qualifier"`. The default is `None`. [adam_derivation]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The source or derivation of an ADaM variable. The default is `None`. [traceability_ref]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A reference from an ADaM variable back to its SDTM source. The default is `None`. [unit]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The unit of measurement, such as `"kg"` or `"years"`. The default is `None`. [unit_system]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The system of units, such as `"SI"`. The default is `None`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Let's look up a variable in the bundled Frictionless Data Package with [`get_variable()`](`pointblank.MetadataImport.get_variable`): ::: {#0eda3e00 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb meta = pb.import_metadata(pb.load_metadata_example("datapackage.json")) var = meta.get_variable("transaction_id") print(var.dtype, var.required, var.unique, var.min_length, var.max_length) print(var.missing_values) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` String True True 5 20 ['NA', 'N/A'] ``` ::: ::: The `transaction_id` field is a required and unique string of 5 to 20 characters, and the package declares `"NA"` and `"N/A"` as its missing-value markers. The CDISC fields are filled in for variables read from a Define-XML document: ::: {#5e6a0cea .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} dm = pb.import_metadata(pb.load_metadata_example("define.xml"), dataset="DM") sex = dm.get_variable("SEX") print(sex.label, sex.max_length, sex.codelist_ref) print(sex.cdisc_domain, sex.cdisc_role) print(sex.allowed_values) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Sex 2 Sex DM Record Qualifier ['M', 'F', 'U'] ``` ::: ::: The `SEX` variable uses the `Sex` codelist, whose values were copied into `allowed_values`. `VariableMetadata` objects can also be created directly, which is how a [`MetadataImport`](`pointblank.MetadataImport`) can be built for data that doesn't come with a metadata file: ::: {#889af865 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} pb.VariableMetadata(name="age", label="Age in years", dtype="Int64", min_val=18, max_val=99) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` VariableMetadata(name='age', label='Age in years', description=None, dtype='Int64', role=None, required=False, unique=False, min_val=18, max_val=99, min_length=None, max_length=None, pattern=None, allowed_values=None, codelist_ref=None, display_format=None, value_labels=None, missing_values=None, missing_value_labels=None, origin=None, computational_method=None, controlled_term=None, significant_digits=None, cdisc_domain=None, cdisc_role=None, adam_derivation=None, traceability_ref=None, unit=None, unit_system=None) ``` ::: ::: Only the fields that are given get a value, and the rest stay at their defaults. ## See Also {.doc-see-also} [](`~MetadataImport`) : The metadata for a dataset, with one of these per variable. [](`~MetadataImport.get_variable`) : Get the metadata of a variable by name. ## Methods {.doc-methods} | Name | Description | |---|---| | [to_missing_spec()](#to_missing_spec){.doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | Build a [`MissingSpec`](`pointblank.MissingSpec`) from this variable's missing values. | : {.gd-summary-table} ### [to_missing_spec()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Build a [`MissingSpec`](`pointblank.MissingSpec`) from this variable's missing values. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/metadata/_types.py#L538-L582){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature to_missing_spec() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Each value in `missing_values` becomes a sentinel value of the spec. Its reason is made from the value's label in `missing_value_labels` or, failing that, in `value_labels`, turned into a lowercase name (`"Not asked"` becomes `"not_asked"`). A value with no label gets a placeholder reason, such as `"missing_99"` for `99`. The result is the same as [`MissingSpec.from_variable_metadata()`](`pointblank.MissingSpec.from_variable_metadata`). ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [MissingSpec | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A `MissingSpec` for the variable, or `None` if the variable declares no missing values. ::: #### Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#c9679be3 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb income = pb.VariableMetadata( name="income", dtype="Int64", missing_values=[-99, -98], missing_value_labels={-99: "Not asked", -98: "Refused"}, ) income.to_missing_spec() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` MissingSpec(reasons={-99: 'not_asked', -98: 'refused'}, categories=None, null_is_missing=True, null_reason='unknown', description="Imported missing values for 'income'") ``` ::: ::: The two labels became the reasons `"not_asked"` and `"refused"`. The spec can be given to the `missing=` parameter of a validation method so that these codes are reported as missing data rather than as failing values. For a variable without missing values the method returns `None`: ::: {#3bb54ecf .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} print(pb.VariableMetadata(name="age", dtype="Int64").to_missing_spec()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` None ``` ::: ::: To get the specs of all the variables of a dataset at once, use [`MetadataImport.missing_specs()`](`pointblank.MetadataImport.missing_specs`).
